Our storyEST. 2025

Many beginnings.
One heart for worship.

House of Judah was established in 2025 by people from different colleges. As we became friends, we decided to start a band, bringing together our love for God and music.

After praying and meditating on God’s Word, we chose the name House of Judah. To us, it represents people united to praise, worship, and glorify God.

Where it began

Youth Christmas

Our first event was at Shine of Shekinah Church, Madhapur, where we led praise and worship.

“
And the remnant that is escaped of the house of Judah shall again take root downward, and bear fruit upward.
Isaiah 37:31

This promise reminds us that even after difficult times, God restores His people, strengthens their roots, and enables them to bear good fruit.

Our vision & mission

Rooted in Him.
In every season.

We are here to build the kingdom of God through praise and worship. Whatever our situation, we believe God never leaves us—and we want to remain faithful to Him.

David danced before the Lord. Even in our pain and struggles, we are invited to turn our hearts towards Him. Our joy is in Jesus.
